04/18.05.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Balumath P. S. Case No. 141/2022, arising out of C. P. Case No. 207/2022, registered under Sections 323/ 341/ 504/ 506/ 498A/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Latehar.
It is alleged that the marriage of the parties was performed in the year 2017.
There marriage could not be consummated because the petitioner was impotent.
It has been alleged that her in- laws including the petitioner pressurized her to have sexual relationship with her Brothers-in-law, but she refused to acquiesce with their wishes.
It is further alleged that mother-in-law of the informant drugged her, due to which she became unconscious.
When she regained consciousness, she saw an unknown person present in her bedroom along with her mother-in-law.
She was informed that step has been taken to impregnate her.
Later on, the informant gave birth to a girl child.
Learned lawyer appearing for the petitioner submitted that the child of the informant was not sired by the petitioner as the petitioner was not in a position to consummate his marriage.
Learned lawyer appearing for the informant has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and has submitted that the victim was sexually assaulted at the instance of accused persons.
